UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Verified Neon World Clock user profile and Freemium/Pro subscription record stored at users/{uid}. Never stores plaintext passwords or raw payment card data.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in Neon World Clock.

emailVerified.description: Verification status; must be true on verified profile persistence.

plan.description: Active subscription tier for the user.

proActivatedAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when Pro plan was activated, or null.

proExpiresAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when 30-day Pro access expires, or null.

activationMethod.description: How the current Pro plan was activated.

isBanned.description: Admin moderation flag; when true, user is immediately blocked from the app.

celebrationShown.description: Tracks whether the Neon Fire Pro Activation Celebration has played for the latest Pro activation.

createdAt.description: Immutable Firestore server timestamp recorded when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp recorded when the profile was last updated.

WatchlistMovie.title: WatchlistMovie
WatchlistMovie.description: Movie saved in a verified user's My List / Watchlist subcollection at users/{uid}/watchlist/{movieId}.

uid.description: Owning Firebase Authentication UID matching parent user document.

movieId.description: Positive TMDB movie ID matching the document ID.

posterPath.description: Relative TMDB poster path or empty string.

backdropPath.description: Relative TMDB backdrop path or empty string.

releaseDate.description: Movie release date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or empty string.

addedAt.description: Immutable Firestore server timestamp recorded when added to My List.

ReceiptEmail.title: ReceiptEmail
ReceiptEmail.description: Immutable Pro activation receipt queued for Firebase Trigger Email extension at mail/{mailId}.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who received the receipt.

transactionId.description: Unique transaction ID matching the document ID.

planName.description: Activated plan name (Neon World Clock Pro (30 Days)).

amountPaid.description: Formatted payment amount or redeem code note.

createdAt.description: Immutable Firestore server timestamp when the receipt was queued.

/users/{uid}.description: Verified user profile and subscription documents isolated to the owning user and verified bootstrapped admin.

/users/{uid}/watchlist/{movieId}.description: User's synced My List / Watchlist movies isolated strictly to the owning verified user.

/mail/{mailId}.description: Create-only immutable receipt email records for Firebase Trigger Email extension.
